svg.title: Asset/fold MAE Skill
svg.desc: Two zero-centered heat maps show MAE Skill for four assets and five folds for LightGBM and the three-seed LSTM metric mean.
svg.text: Cell labels are percentage points; blue is positive and orange is negative
LightGBM: positive skill in 12/20 cells. LSTM: negative skill in 16/20 cells.
LSTM metrics were computed by seed and then averaged; predictions were not ensembled and no best seed was chosen.
A shared color scale preserves cross-model comparability; exact labels remain visible for small effects.
Descriptive results for this frozen protocol; not a universal model ranking.
